items.title: With the addition of Klay Thompson, the Miami Heat now have 7 players above 38 3PT% on the team (Portis 46%; THJ 41%; Wiggins 41%; Gardner 41%; Davion Mitchell 41%; Klay 38%; Fontechhio 38%), 2nd in shooting depth in the NBA behind only the Knicks, and 4 players in the top 50 in 3pt%.
